nodes.label: 01 Master PRD — RuangKPR
nodes.rationale: Product source of truth; explicitly not an approval to start coding until open questions are answered or deferred.

nodes.label: Know → Warn → Act product principle
nodes.rationale: Know = understand KPR/capacity/schedule; Warn = payment reminders + fixed-to-floating early warning; Act = simulate, compare, apply to one bank/program.

nodes.label: Principle: Estimate is not approval
nodes.rationale: All calculator results carry assumptions and disclaimers.

nodes.label: Principle: No silent data submission
nodes.rationale: Data goes to a bank only after consent and explicit Submit/Ajukan Sekarang.

nodes.label: One application = one bank/program
nodes.rationale: No multi-bank submission in MVP; matches initial one-bank operating model.

nodes.label: Principle: Deterministic financial math
nodes.rationale: Calculations done by engine; AI never produces authoritative numbers.

nodes.label: Principle: No false integration claims
nodes.rationale: Manual payments must not look bank-synced.

nodes.label: B2C personas A–D (buyer, reminder-only owner, take-over, top-up)
Five always-enabled nav items (Home / My KPR / Explore / Activity / Profile)
Visual baseline (Plus Jakarta Sans, #003DA5, #F4F6FA, Command Center header)
nodes.rationale: No new shell/visual language without explicit approval.

nodes.label: Application state machine (draft→submitted→…→completed; rejected; cancelled)
Mortgage state machine (draft→active→closed)
nodes.rationale: mortgage.draft is used for unfinished monitoring setup and never creates an application.

nodes.label: Home render priority (PRD: rejected > in-process > app draft > setup draft > near-floating > floating > normal > fresh)
nodes.rationale: Adopted by the implementation (CLAUDE.md: Home priority follows 01/04/05).

nodes.label: MVP assumption: one active draft/application and one active mortgage per user
MoSCoW scope (Must/Should/Could/Won't)
KPR Secondary removed as a separate product
nodes.rationale: Primary covers both new and used houses; no separate Secondary flow/engine.

nodes.label: KPR Primary application (new + used house, 5 steps)
Payment capacity rule (ratio_config × income − existing debt, default 35%)
nodes.rationale: 35% is a prototype default only; ratio must be configurable per product/bank policy, and over-capacity programs stay visible with a warning.

nodes.label: Rule-based bank product matching
nodes.rationale: Rule-based, not AI; recommendation label only when eligible, within capacity, product data current, and best by sort objective.

nodes.label: Application draft/resume (autosave on Simpan & Lanjutkan)
Application tracker (Diajukan → … → Selesai)
nodes.rationale: Tracker must reflect backend status, not a fake timer.

nodes.label: Rejected recovery paths (Ajukan ke Bank Lain / Perbaiki & Ajukan Ulang)
Cancel = hard delete pre-akad (open compliance validation)
nodes.rationale: Current product decision; must switch to soft-delete/retention if regulation requires retaining submitted data.

nodes.label: Existing KPR monitoring setup (6-step wizard)
Payment-changed accuracy branch (no reverse-engineering when payment changed)
nodes.rationale: If payment ever changed, a single-rate solve is mathematically invalid; official outstanding is required.

nodes.label: Rate periods fixed → fixed → floating
nodes.rationale: Ordered, no overlap, no unexplained gap, rate > 0, future floating always estimate.

nodes.label: Reminder defaults (H-7/H-3/H-1; fixed expiry H-90/60/30/14/7; in-app+email; WhatsApp disabled)
Home monitoring dashboard (Health, Next Payment, Warning, Progress, Opportunity; no charts)
KPR Health composite score (partial when inputs missing)
nodes.rationale: Not a bank credit score; formula/weights configurable and documented; partial score instead of fake precision.

nodes.label: Fixed-to-floating early warning (0 < days_until_fixed_end ≤ 90)
Already-floating state (no countdown)
Partial-data state (missing property value / rate / outstanding)
nodes.rationale: Missing data yields explicit partial states, never fabricated numbers; reminders stay active.

nodes.label: My KPR tabs (Overview | Payment | Rate | Property)
Manual payment is user-recorded, not bank-confirmed
Amortization (My KPR → Payment → Lihat Jadwal Amortisasi)
nodes.rationale: Not a top-level nav item.

nodes.label: Amortization financial invariants (Σprincipal = opening, final balance 0)
Generate schedule from inputs; do not persist rows
nodes.rationale: Cache only if measured performance needs it; snapshot may be needed later for audit/export.

nodes.label: Explore product cards only with active mortgage (not rendered, not disabled)
Take Over ordering signals (floating_signal, opportunity_signal)
nodes.rationale: Floating framing first when both; Refinancing/Multiguna badges deferred until reliable valuation rules exist.

nodes.label: Simulation separated from application (Simpan Simulasi / Ajukan Sekarang)
nodes.rationale: Saving a simulation never creates an application; only Apply Now creates a prefilled draft.

nodes.label: Take Over product (existing-mortgage entry vs cold entry)
Take Over tracker with Old KPR Settlement stage
nodes.rationale: User must keep paying old bank until official payoff confirmation.

nodes.label: Refinancing + Top-up requirement framework
nodes.rationale: Needs partner policy validation; no authoritative recommendation until policies exist.

nodes.label: Multiguna requirement framework
nodes.rationale: Reuse Calculation Engine + Bank Product Engine with product_type=multiguna; no separate engine unless bank rules differ materially.

nodes.label: Activity & notification reliability (idempotent scheduling, dedupe, preferences)
Conceptual data model (users, applications, mortgages, rate_periods, payments, bank_products…)
Calculation Engine requirements (annuity, outstanding, solve-rate, DTI, LTV, take-over)
nodes.rationale: PRD asks for decimal-safe money; doc 03 resolves this with integer Rupiah + bps on native Number.

nodes.label: Break-even rule (monthly_benefit ≤ 0 → no positive break-even)
AI boundary (may explain, never produce rates/balances/eligibility)
Bank product data governance (versioned, effective dates, stale threshold)
nodes.rationale: Stale product data is a top operational risk; stale beyond threshold → warning or disable recommendation.

nodes.label: Security, privacy, consent & compliance requirements
Non-functional requirements (performance, WCAG 2.1 AA, responsive)
Analytics & success metrics (north-star meaningful KPR action)
Failure paths & edge cases (15)
Delivery phases 0–5
MVP Definition of Done (PRD)
Confirmed product decisions
Risks & mitigation
